bridge.assembly_method: New assembled art, not a simple crop export: copy retained outer masonry/parapet/arch-front columns 1:1 after the sole uniform source reduction, with split/staggered added cobble courses. Original inner jagged faces and approved runtime bridge images are unchanged.
bridge.framing_limitation: 480px viewport shows the central collapse, both broken abutment faces and inner portions of both damage parcels; the eastern terminal approach is partly cropped. Use the unscaled 960x480 bridge reference to inspect the whole 504px physical deck and both complete scorch parcels.
bridge.note: Only this newly authored bridge is assembled art, not a simple crop export of the approved runtime bridge. One uniform 232/1774 stone scale supplies both unchanged inner jagged faces and 84px of additional retained OUTER masonry/parapet/arch-front columns per bank. Two outer panel strips and three split/staggered cobble courses form each 200px abutment without repainting or stretching the source. The actual transparent collapse is measured from output alpha. The full physical 18-tile deck stays 504x72px under the unchanged projection; river, camera and actor registration are unchanged.

mask_contract: Native L-mode 0/255 masks retain exact projected source roads/fields/river/scorch before cosmetic feathering. actor_clearance and worn_verge_variation are explicitly nongeographic authoring reservations, not new roads or changes to region.json.

route.sampling_note: At most 1 tile between arc samples. Canonical short bridge-approach eastward nudge is retained in road_source_tile_points; these exact centerline arc samples and camera x positions are strictly westward.
